name: Nicholas Michael Petriello

residences.place: 1028 Bunker Hill Street, Scranton Ward 10, Pennsylvania, USA
residences.note: 'Nicholas Petranello', head, 29, laborer; wife Genevieve 26 (in Taylor in 1935); daughter Grace, under 1 year old.

bioAdditions: In April 1940 Nicholas, his wife Genevieve and their baby daughter Grace rented a unit in the family house at 1028 Bunker Hill Street (S1). As 'Nick Petrillo' he was a surviving brother of Josephine Castellano in November 1995 (S2).

sources.citation: 1940 US census, Scranton Ward 10, Lackawanna Co., PA, ED 71-64, sheet 4B (enumerated 20 Apr 1940), Bunker Hill Street nos. 1020-1028: households of James 'Petranello' (28), Nicholas 'Petranello' (29), Charles 'Petranello' (33), DiBiasi (1022) and Genello (1020).
